# Test-only axe-core 4.10.3

Unmodified `axe.min.js` and `LICENSE` from the official npm distribution at
https://registry.npmjs.org/axe-core/-/axe-core-4.10.3.tgz.
`provenance.json` records the registry archive integrity and extracted file
SHA-256/size pins. The browser suite independently asserts the script digest,
size, version and license digest before auditing. This directory is never
imported by runtime source. Injection uses Playwright evaluation only, leaving
production CSP intact; `bypassCSP` is never enabled.
